mapper.select: SELECT owi.id, owi.code, owid.id AS detailId, owi.create_time, owi.create_user_name, owi.create_user_id, owi.dict_platform, owi.source_code AS sourceCode, owi.source_id AS sourceId, owi.source_type AS sourceType, owi.instock_type AS instockType, owi.instock_status AS instockStatus, owi.delivery_warehouse_name, owi.delivery_warehouse_id, owi.transfer_warehouse_name, owi.transfer_warehouse_id, owi.to_warehouse_name, owi.to_warehouse_id, owi.logistics_method AS logisticsMethod, owi.remark, owi.receive_time, owi.estimated_arrival_date, owi.finish_reason, owi.finish_status, owi.overseas_warehouse_inbound_id, owi.delivery_mode AS deliveryMode, owid.platform_product_name, owid.platform_sku_no, owid.product_name, owid.sku_no, owid.sku_id, owid.is_combination, owid.receive_qty, owid.transport_qty, owid.pack_qty, owid.diff_qty, owid.receive_time AS detailReceiveTime, owid.receive_status AS receiveStatus, owid.receive_type AS receiveType FROM overseas_warehouse_inbound owi INNER JOIN overseas_warehouse_inbound_detail owid ON owi.id = owid.main_id where

SELECT owi.id, owi.code, owid.id AS detailId, owi.create_time, owi.create_user_name, owi.create_user_id, owi.dict_platform, owi.source_code, owi.source_id, owi.source_type, owi.instock_type, owi.instock_status, owi.delivery_warehouse_name, owi.delivery_warehouse_id, owi.transfer_warehouse_name, owi.transfer_warehouse_id, owi.to_warehouse_name, owi.to_warehouse_id, owi.logistics_method, owi.remark, owi.receive_time, owi.estimated_arrival_date, owi.finish_reason, owi.finish_status, owi.overseas_warehouse_inbound_id, owi.delivery_mode, owid.platform_product_name, owid.platform_sku_no, owid.product_name, owid.sku_no, owid.sku_id, owid.is_combination, owid.receive_qty, owid.transport_qty, owid.pack_qty, owid.diff_qty, owid.receive_time AS detailReceiveTime, owid.receive_status, owid.receive_type FROM overseas_warehouse_inbound owi INNER JOIN overseas_warehouse_inbound_detail owid ON owi.id = owid.main_id where
SELECT instock_status AS tabFlag, COUNT(*) AS count FROM overseas_warehouse_inbound GROUP BY instock_status

SELECT h.id,T.code source_code, G.sku_no, G.platform_sku_no, T.to_warehouse_name, h.receive_qty::VARCHAR receive_qty, TO_CHAR( h.receive_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) receive_time FROM overseas_warehouse_inbound T LEFT JOIN overseas_warehouse_inbound_detail G ON t.id = g.main_id left join overseas_warehouse_inbound_received h on g.id = h.detail_id
SELECT count(h.id) FROM overseas_warehouse_inbound T LEFT JOIN overseas_warehouse_inbound_detail G ON t.id = g.main_id left join overseas_warehouse_inbound_received h on g.id = h.detail_id

SELECT owi.source_code as businessCode, owid.sku_id, SUM(CASE WHEN owir.receive_time >= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{params.month}::date - INTERVAL '1 month') AND DATE_TRUNC('month', #{params.month}::date) > owir.receive_time THEN owir.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonthReceiveQty, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM owir.receive_time) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM #{params.month}::date) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM owir.receive_time) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM #{params.month}::date) THEN owir.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonthReceiveQty, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', #{params.month}::date) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', owir.receive_time) AND owir.receive_time >= '2024-01-01' THEN owir.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS asCurrentMonthReceiveQty, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', #{params.month}::date - INTERVAL '1 month') >= DATE_TRUNC('month', owir.receive_time) AND owir.receive_time >= '2024-01-01' THEN owir.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS asLastMonthReceiveQty FROM overseas_warehouse_inbound owi LEFT JOIN overseas_warehouse_inbound_detail owid ON owi.ID = owid.main_id AND owid.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN overseas_warehouse_inbound_received owir ON owid.ID = owir.detail_id AND owir.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE owi.is_deleted = FALSE AND owi.source_type = 'firstMileDelivery'
and owi.code in
#{item}
GROUP BY businessCode,owid.sku_id
